criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: The return plate frames are the strongest art these decks have had: real height, threaded bores with lit rims, brass plugs with lit flats, casts off the declared key. Frame 4 passes the showstopper test outright and 9 is a true reverse of the cover. Four frames fall short. Frame 8 reads as a safe door with a combination dial on a mid-grey sheet. Frame 6 is untextured grey clay with no ground or contact, gantry clutter and a nameplate square behind the footer's 'c12'. Frame 5's tanks read as pucks on a lit mid-tone floor with aliasing roof seams and no scale. Frame 3's top third is streaky brown haze behind the figure. Frame 7 reads as a ruler on a rail.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Two devices work, the camera move around one plate and the tank becoming the farm's unit. One light holds and the brass accent is disciplined. Frame 6 is grey clay against the iron and brass, 7 and 8 are desk objects from a different deck, and value strobes mildly on 3, 5, 7 and 8.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, the computed figures and tank geometry check out, the four cautions are obeyed, and the ERCOT side is primary. The threshold and the operating-only reach lean on the Tribune, 'the developer's own utility' glosses c21, and 'before the power flows' is interpretive.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns what happened, who decides and when. No place, and the next step is to watch for a report.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays exactly, the turn lands, 7 carries the caution and the close returns reversed. Frame 5 is cuttable and 3 and 4 restate the survey's terms.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, specific and on register. The repeated hedges read machine-made, and frame 7's dek is a run of protocol nouns.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The concept and palette are fresh against 59 and 58. The staged lastLight register, one skeleton on all nine frames and a plan relief on a dark ground repeat house moves.

one_sentence_fix: Keep the turn inside the plate's world: frame 8's seal as a flat crimped disc with ribbon tails on a cream sheet with no folder border, and frame 6 recropped tight on the bushings and conservator against black sky with weathered galvanized steel.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads as a steel safe door with a combination dial, framed by the folder, the sheet mid grey.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A flat embossed disc with a crimped scalloped rim and ribbon tails, no folder border, a cream sheet with the pool falling to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured grey clay with no ground or contact, gantry clutter and a nameplate behind 'c12'.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Recrop on the three tallest bushings and the conservator against black sky, weather the tank, delete the nameplate and drop the gantry.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pucks on a lit mid-tone floor with aliasing seams and no scale.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the pool onto the nearest two blocks so the ground falls to black, light the shells' flanks, and stand the data hall at the near left edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Streaky brown haze behind the figure.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pitch down until the far edge leaves the top of the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A ruler on a rail with a flat copper fill and hidden standoffs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Standoffs clear of the bar with their own casts, the web dark outside a pool on the step, and a bevelled lit arris on the copper.
